description: Photograph of U.S. Senator John McCain (seated at right) meeting with a group of men in a furnished room during his May 2013 visit to Syria; a Syrian opposition (Free Syrian Army) flag stands in the corner. The image circulated with claims that the men were ISIS members, including that one was Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi; fact-checkers identified the group as Free Syrian Army / Northern Storm Brigade figures, not ISIS. The archive filename WDSHN_ISIS_TRAITOR_NN reflects the Q-community claim (WDSHN = We Dont Say His Name, a Q nickname for McCain).
flags: Filename/circulating captions claim the men are ISIS members incl. al-Baghdadi - this claim is debunked; the men other than McCain are not identified here

description: Formal group photograph from former President Bill Clintons August 2009 visit to Pyongyang, North Korea, to secure the release of two detained American journalists. Clinton sits beside North Korean leader Kim Jong-il in front of a large sea-wave mural, with six members of the U.S. delegation standing behind them. Contemporary reporting placed John Podesta and Doug Band in this delegation, but the standing figures are not individually identified here.
flags: Standing delegation members not individually identified; Podesta/Band presence is from reporting on the visit, not visible ID

description: Official-style photograph of U.S. Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg seated in an ornate carved armchair opposite a Vietnamese official in a government reception room; a Vietnamese flag stands behind him and a lotus flower arrangement sits on the table between them. The setting is consistent with Ginsburgs August 2015 visit to Vietnam, during which she met Prime Minister Nguyen Tan Dung, but the officials identity is inferred from that context rather than shown in the image.
flags: Vietnamese official consistent with then-PM Nguyen Tan Dung (2015 visit) but identified from context, not certain; location/date inferred
